stage: source-only annotation before seeing generated summaries
scope: Exactly three selected atomic central propositions per article. These are AI-assisted source-grounded anchors, not human preference labels, an exhaustive inventory of article content, or a percentage denominator for all content.
excluded_inputs: No candidate instructions, training evidence, generation prompts, generated summaries, automatic output scores, or other agents' work were read.

feasibility_limits.finding: The three anchors require at least three distinct original sentences: the tentative natural-cause assessment, the absence of a criminal investigation, and the planned autopsy. No one- or two-sentence fully extractive selection can cover all three.
feasibility_limits.interpretation: Keep all three fixed anchors. A coverage loss under this condition is partly a format/content feasibility tradeoff and is not itself a hallucination or a defect unique to a generation method.

source_qualifications.finding: The cause-of-death assessment is preliminary; an autopsy was still planned. Apparent natural causes must not become a confirmed medical determination.
Relevant suspected acts, charges or causal findings are attributed to authorities. These anchors do not establish a conviction or independent proof beyond the source's stated account.
Officials give conflicting exact release counts of 217 and 228. F1 therefore fixes the shared claim of more than 200; the motive for release remains unknown.
The research proposes an earlier death period, but the source explicitly leaves the exact death dates unclear. The anchors preserve that distinction.
These articles contain evaluative political or security commentary. The central evaluative anchors are the article's assessments, not independently verified facts or human preference judgments.

The relevant claims remain respectively a pending policy decision, an uncertain threat, box-office projections, and suspected pesticide causation. Evidence of a process, forecast or chemical presence does not establish its completed outcome or cause.

validation: Selection: 6 cases and 18 facts. Final: 18 cases and 54 facts. Every evidence string was checked as an exact substring of its own article. No external information or paid model API was used.
feasibility_review_scope: The short fully-extractive cases in the supplied profiles were D01, T08 and T16. Only D01 had an identified incompatibility between all three fixed anchors and the one- or two-sentence limit. This is a pre-output source review, not a guarantee of any output's coverage or readability.
